_comment: SEALED. Loaded ONLY by evaluate_mock6.py after the run finished. run_mock6.py and controller.py never read this file (the runner asserts it is not imported/opened).
actual_root_problem: Billing import validation rule BV-17 (deployed 08-01) compares firmware-v4.2 AMI register values, reported in 0.1 m3 units, against m3 history without unit scaling. Valid on-time AMI reads are rejected as HIGH_CONSUMPTION and replaced with estimates; the estimated bills drive the dispute surge.

ideal_initial_hypotheses.H-SLOW: requester framing: slow dispute responses -> should be rejected pre-canonical by CRM response-time data (within SLA)
ideal_initial_hypotheses.H-READS: missed / late field reads -> estimated bills -> disputes (plausible, becomes v1)
ideal_initial_hypotheses.H-TARIFF: tariff change -> should be rejected pre-canonical (no tariff change)

ideal_initial_canonical_problem: field read-route backlog causes estimated bills that drive disputes (v1). Plausible on visible evidence: 41% of disputed bills are ESTIMATED read type; route completion 88% vs 95% target; field manager reports short staffing.
ideal_pre_canonical_transition: hypothesis_changed (H-SLOW rejected, H-TARIFF rejected); NOT redefine

ideal_redefine_trigger.evidence: MDMS system-of-record read event export: for 1,184 of 1,240 ESTIMATED disputed bills a valid AMI read arrived before billing cutoff and was exported; billing import status REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION; all 1,184 are firmware v4.2 meters; disputed accounts are AMI accounts, not manual-read routes.
ideal_redefine_trigger.why_redefine_not_replan: The central causal premise of v1 (estimates exist because reads were not collected) is false. It is not that the route-prioritization path is unsuitable for a valid problem; the problem itself is different (upstream data-contract / validation failure).

ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.

ideal_invalidation_scope.ProblemDefinition v1: INVALIDATED / SUPERSEDED by v2 (kept in history)
ideal_invalidation_scope.Evidence E-BILL-READTYPE: observation STILL_VALID; interpretation revised (ESTIMATED != not read); still citable for the symptom
ideal_invalidation_scope.Evidence E-ROUTE: observation STILL_VALID; interpretation revised (route lag real but not causal for disputed AMI accounts)
ideal_invalidation_scope.VOB-U-ROUTE-IMPACT: INVALIDATED (tied only to v1 causal premise)
ideal_invalidation_scope.VOB-U-TAG: STILL_VALID (CRM tag reliability affects dispute KPI under both problems)
ideal_invalidation_scope.SuccessCriterion SC-EST-SHARE: STILL_VALID (estimated share among disputes is still the right outcome metric)
ideal_invalidation_scope.Domain authorization DA-DISPATCH: STILL_VALID as a fact, but no longer relevant to active scope

ideal_new_vob: Does scaling firmware-v4.2 reads by 0.1 produce correct consumption for every v4.2 meter, including genuine high-usage / leak cases? (critical, blocks corrected-read / re-bill scope)
ideal_minimum_useful_solution: detect rejected AMI reads on firmware v4.2 (MDMS x billing import status) + classify affected disputed accounts + manual escalation queue to Billing Ops; corrected-read proposals and re-bill stay out of release scope until the new VOB is resolved; structural remedy = vendor patch to BV-17 (bridge with sunset).
expected_failure_traps: anchoring on requester framing (agent auto-answers tickets)
treating late MDMS evidence as an extra exception and replanning route prioritization
treating MDMS ACCESS_PENDING tool failure as redefine
executing push_route_update after its premise was invalidated
keeping VOB-U-ROUTE-IMPACT open / blocking under v2, or dropping VOB-U-TAG
releasing v2 with an AgentSpec / VOB list that still references v1 reasoning
full reset rediscovery of org/process/tool facts after redefine

evaluation_rubric.C1: pre-canonical change handled as hypothesis_changed; harness refuses redefine before canonical problem exists/active
evaluation_rubric.C2: after canonical v1, authoritative contradiction -> redefine (harness-derived, not operator-asserted); replan-type evidence must not yield redefine
evaluation_rubric.C3: v1 and v2 coexist with traceable link, trigger evidence, order, reason
evaluation_rubric.C4: old and late evidence preserved with provenance
evaluation_rubric.C5: revision records old/new interpretation, trigger, affected objects
evaluation_rubric.C6: v1-dependent objects classified (still valid / re-eval / invalidated / superseded) dependency-aware
evaluation_rubric.C7: no full reset; only problem-dependent items re-derived
evaluation_rubric.C8: final release uses v2, no stale v1 decisions/VOBs/spec active
